tara.arch: Quick sync: RFC moved heavy policy checks to control plane. For strictly airgapped sites we need a minimal verifiable contract so operator UX stays simple. Thoughts?

joe.ops: Minimal contract = signed envelope with bundle-id, signer-id, policy-hash, allow-bits, expiry. Operator only checks signature, expiry, integrity, and bitmask.

mike.runtime: Important: keep crypto primitives small and deterministic. No CRL fetches. Use rotateable keyring with explicit bootstrap flow.

anya.sre: Add operational modes: strict (deny if missing), confirm (admin must approve), and legacy-accept (for old installs). Document explicit admin confirmation for confirm mode.

tara.arch: Agreed. Action items: joe to draft envelope schema, mike to build tiny verifier lib (Go), anya to add test cases for low-spec VMs and clock skew. I’ll update RFC appendix.

deploy-bot: RFC draft pushed: https://git.redwood.internal/rfcs/airgap-envelope. Commit by joe.ops.

tara.arch: Thanks team, meeting Monday 10am PT to review PoC.
